gaps.sentence: If the taxi ___ in five minutes, we are going to miss our flight.
gaps.hint: real future risk in the if-clause
gaps.explanation: Real future conditions take the present simple in the if-clause: does not arrive.

gaps.sentence: If the alarm ___ , everyone must leave by the stairs.
gaps.explanation: Real possibility: if + present simple, will/modal.

gaps.sentence: We will refund the item provided that you ___ the receipt.
gaps.hint: provided that plus a present requirement
gaps.explanation: 'Provided that' states a requirement using the present simple: have.

gaps.sentence: If the route ___ safer, I would cycle to work.
gaps.hint: an imaginary present situation, subjunctive were
gaps.explanation: Unreal present conditions formally take 'were' rather than 'is': were.

gaps.sentence: In case of fire, ___ the nearest exit.
gaps.hint: in case of plus an emergency instruction
gaps.explanation: 'In case of' plus a noun introduces an emergency instruction with the imperative: use.

gaps.sentence: Unless something urgent ___, I will be at my desk all morning.
gaps.hint: unless introduces the exception, present simple
gaps.explanation: 'Unless' introduces the exception to the plan and takes the present simple: comes up.

gaps.sentence: You can borrow the car ___ you return it by Sunday.
gaps.explanation: 'Provided you return it' sets a condition.

gaps.sentence: He wishes he ___ harder at school when he had the chance.
gaps.hint: past regret, wish plus past perfect
gaps.explanation: Regret about past behavior takes the past perfect after 'wish': had worked.
